verdict.rationale: Polar documents payouts (withdrawals once a minimum balance is met), an available-balance view on the Finance page, refund issuance, and public fee rates. None of this amounts to itemized settlement-to-bank-deposit reconciliation reports. Chargeback reporting and per-payout breakdowns of fees and refunds are not evidenced, so these related features are adjacent only and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can reconcile settlements to bank deposits with itemized reports covering fees, refunds, and chargebacks
